title: Farm Puffs for Golden Carrot
description: Replaces the golden carrot with delectable farm puffs from abiotic factor!
body:
A resourcepack that replaces golden carrots with the delectable snack "Farm Puffs" from Abiotic Factor.

I have also made a version for both the baked potato, and dried kelp :

[FarmPuffsBakedPotato](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/farm-puffs-baked-potato)         
[FarmPuffsDriedKelp](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/farm-puffs-dried-kelp)

Be sure to check out Abiotic Factor on steam. It's a genuinely great multiplayer survival game

[AbioticFactorSteamLink](https://store.steampowered.com/app/427410/Abiotic_Factor/)
